title: Rowing Stroke Rate Drift During Long Pieces
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=concept2:workout distance_m>=5000
| stats avg(stroke_rate_spm) as avg_spm, stdev(stroke_rate_spm) as spm_sd by workout_id athlete
| where avg_spm>18 AND spm_sd>3
| sort - spm_sd
description: Uses Concept2 long-piece sessions telemetry to monitor stroke-rate stability in rows long enough to expose pacing issues in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for pieces where technique drifted under fatigue, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Concept2 long-piece sessions data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Table of long pieces with average stroke rate and deviation.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds stroke-rate stability in rows long enough to expose pacing issues so you can spot pieces where technique drifted under fatigue before it becomes annoying.
